call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished fictional roller-skate-night event poster as a single flat square 1:1 artwork. Full-bleed artwork, no mockup, no panels or contact sheet. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual idea: the repeated beat of quad-skate wheels pressing against the floor and an outward push drives the composition. From a low, close, three-quarter side view, show a believable pair of worn black quad roller-skate boots connected to two cropped lower legs in a skating push: the nearer skate rolls firmly under the body's weight; the other skate angles outward to propel. Boots, soles, metal trucks, axles and four-wheel structure must connect correctly. Show recognizable wheels and a coherent grounded action, with compressed contact shadows at wheel-to-floor contact, rather than a floating product still life. Crop the legs naturally at the upper edge of the skate scene; no face or unrelated objects.

Typography and space: make the title the first visual read, large and immediately legible, its heavy Korean forms assembled as two weighty word masses with a clear natural word space. The title uses real deep three-dimensional extrusion and highly reflective silver chrome, crisp intact front faces, controlled bevels, visible dark metal depth and bright neon reflections. The letter volumes have a firm horizontal bearing and deliberate intervals that echo the near wheel-contact rhythm below, without breaking Hangul into fragments. A substantial title spans the upper field; the tightly framed boots and the row of actual contact points occupy the middle field, visually close enough that the chrome reflections and floor lighting connect title weight to skating rhythm. Do not turn the title into a tunnel or a travel route. Keep every title stroke recognizable and keep the full title inside the canvas.

Strong neon lighting is mandatory: an intense saturated cyan light source from the left and hot coral-magenta from the right create distinct, localized light pools at the wheel contacts, sharp colored edge-light on the chrome letter extrusion, and powerful but physically consistent reflected highlights. The night background and floor stay very dark graphite. The floor is satin, with short controlled reflections under the wheels; boot leather stays largely matte, metal trucks differ from polyurethane wheels, and only the title is mirror chrome. The few reflected streaks originate at real contacts and indicate the direction of the push. No generic glowing rings, random light rails, glowing dust or decorative duplicates of wheels.

Readable practical invitation: reserve a substantial stable lower area for the supplied details, not tiny captions. Use clean pale neutral Korean sans-serif text with open counters, precise spacing, a calm baseline, no glow or 3D effects on information. Group the date/time with the venue as one invitation, then admission with the complete booking line as another; choose natural line lengths and modest spacing without adding headings. The event-description line is secondary to the title but clearly readable near the title/skate transition. All details should remain easy to read in a 720-pixel-wide screen view. The visual reading path runs from chrome title to grounded skating action to date/place and admission/booking. Protect text from flare, floor reflections and objects.

Print only the following six exact copy items, each exactly once. Preserve every spelling, ordinary word space, punctuation, number, middle dot, colon, comma, en dash and URL. No additional printable text. Natural wrapping at word boundaries is allowed:
밤의 활주
롤러스케이트 나이트
2026.12.12 · 20:00–23:00
루나 플로어 · 하람시 유성로 19
입장 15,000원 · 장비 대여 포함
예약: moonroll.example

Finish: precise Korean lettering, clean edges, coherent perspective and surfaces, strong controlled neon contrast. Do not invent any extra event information, slogan, label, badge, logo, watermark, numbering or fake microtext. Do not duplicate the title or any supplied copy. No unrelated props, interface elements or artwork marks.
